 Gold Prices Today Hyderabad: Rates Rise On October 24 
 Gold Price Today | Hyderabad, Oct 24: Gold Prices Today Hyderabad declined on Friday, October 24, 2026 , with prices falling across 22 carat, 24 carat and 18 carat gold .
 The supplied rates show that 22 carat gold rise by ₹100 to ₹1,30,700 per 10 grams. Meanwhile, 24 carat gold increased  by ₹100 to ₹1,42,580 per 10 grams.
 The price of 18 carat gold also increased by ₹80 to ₹1,06,940 per 10 grams.
 Gold Prices Today Hyderabad: Silver and Platinum Prices
 Silver in Hyderabad is priced at ₹2,20,000 per kilogram. Platinum is trading at ₹4,725 per gram, according to the supplied rates.
 The latest figures indicate a decline in gold prices across all three purity categories. However, actual jewellery purchase prices may vary between jewellers.
 Buyers should also account for applicable GST and jewellery making charges when calculating the final bill. Rates may change during the day depending on market movements and local pricing.

 22 carat gold: ₹1,30,700 per 10 grams, rise ₹100

 Note: These prices are based on the rates supplied for this report. Retail prices may vary by jeweller and may exclude taxes and making charges.
